Package com.lemarketjames.auth.dto

Class RegisterRequest

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.auth.dto.RegisterRequest
public class RegisterRequest extends Object
Data transfer object for user registration requests. Contains comprehensive user information needed for account creation.
